## What this site is

Unofficial **personal study notes** for publicly available lecture series (starting with NPTEL *Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning*).

This site is **not** affiliated with NPTEL, IISc, or the course instructors.

## What we publish

- Original notes and explanations written for learning
- Tutorials and code examples created for this site
- Links to official lecture videos and course pages

## What we do not publish

- Lecture video or audio files
- Official course PDFs/slides redistributed wholesale
- Verbatim lecture transcripts

## Credit

When notes follow a specific lecture, the page names the course, instructor, and links the source video.

Example: Prof. Prathosh A.P., NPTEL / IISc — [Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning](https://nptel.ac.in/courses/106108841).

## Your use

You may read and learn from these notes. If you reuse material, please keep attribution to both this site and the original lecture sources.
